items.heading: Fondue
details: Key ingredients: cheese, white wine, garlic, bread
Rub a pot with a cut garlic clove.
Melt grated cheese into simmering white wine, stirring constantly.
Continue stirring until smooth and glossy.
Keep warm over a small flame and dip cubes of bread into the cheese.

items.heading: Rosti
details: Key ingredients: grated potato, butter, salt
Grate potatoes and squeeze out excess moisture.
Season and pack the potato into a hot buttered pan.
Fry until a deep golden crust forms on the bottom.
Flip carefully and crisp the other side before serving.
